name: @therealityreport/tweakers
description: Tweak system for the OpenAI Codex desktop app

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-sdk && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-native-host && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-runtime && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-loader && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-installer
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-sdk && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-native-host && npm run build --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-switcher && node --import ./scripts/test-root-preload.mjs --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts && node --import ./scripts/test-root-preload.mjs --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:tweaks && npm test --workspace @therealityreport/tweakers-mcp-lifecycle
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/installer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json
